tasks.name: I Can't Reach That
steps: Bring freezing spells and a magic weapon; keep Scorpia outside melee range.
Freeze her again after each freeze ends, and finish the kill without letting her reach you.

tasks.name: Guardians No More
steps: Fight Scorpia until her guardians appear, then stop attacking the guardians.
Freeze or separate them from Scorpia to prevent healing; kill Scorpia while both guardians remain alive or have despawned.

tasks.name: Fragment of Seren Speed-Trialist
steps: Use the Memory of Seren in the Pool of Dreams to start the repeat fight; prepare magic gear and healing supplies.
Destroy healing pillars quickly and identify the real Seren among her clones.
Keep attacking between specials and finish in less than 4 minutes; heal before her large unavoidable hit.

tasks.name: A Frozen Foe from the Past
steps: Enter the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon with 72 Slayer and a suitable wyvern shield equipped, such as an elemental or mind shield.
Keep the shield equipped while killing one Skeletal Wyvern; protection prayers alone do not replace breath protection.

tasks.name: Zulrah Adept
steps: Bring venom protection, food and ranged/magic gear to Zul-Andra; start the fight from the boat.
Move to safe tiles as Zulrah changes position, switch protection prayers for the incoming attacks, and avoid venom clouds.
Accumulate 25 kills; bank between attempts as needed.

tasks.name: Zulrah Veteran
steps: Prepare venom protection and ranged/magic switches before boarding at Zul-Andra.
Follow Zulrah's rotations, move out of clouds and protect against the incoming attack style.
Reach 75 total kills; the kills do not need to be in one trip.

tasks.name: Zulrah Master
steps: Take venom protection and enough supplies for reliable Zulrah kills.
Learn the safe positions and prayer changes for each rotation before trying longer trips.
Accumulate 150 kills, banking whenever needed.

tasks.name: Snake Rebound
steps: Bring Vengeance on the Lunar spellbook and a way to survive Zulrah's next hit.
Lower Zulrah's health, then stop attacking and remove passive damage that could finish her.
Cast Vengeance and let Zulrah's own hit trigger the reflected killing blow.

tasks.name: Snake. Snake!? Snaaaaaake!
steps: Keep at least three snakelings alive long enough to group them together; bring an area attack.
Hit the grouped snakelings with one area attack so three die simultaneously; separate kills do not count.

tasks.name: Perfect Zulrah
steps: Use the correct protection against the green phase; move away from the crimson phase's targeted melee strikes.
Avoid venom clouds and prevent snakelings from damaging you throughout the kill.
Finish Zulrah with none of the listed damage; blue-phase damage is permitted by this task.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Trialist
steps: Attempt this while not on a Zulrah Slayer assignment; prepare boosts and ranged/magic switches before entry.
Attack promptly whenever Zulrah emerges and switch gear while she submerges.
Finish in less than 1 minute 20 seconds without losing attacks to avoidable damage or slow movement.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Chaser
steps: Start off a Zulrah Slayer task, with boosts and your switches ready.
Keep attacks going through each rotation and use movement between phases to change equipment.
Finish in less than 1 minute; restart attempts with slow openings rather than forcing a poor run.

tasks.name: Zulrah Speed-Runner
steps: Ensure no Zulrah Slayer assignment is active; prepare boosts and your most effective available weapons.
Minimise missed attacks and use special attacks where they improve damage.
Finish in less than 54 seconds; a favourable rotation and strong hits may require repeated attempts.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Supreme Champion
steps: Bring melee gear for Supreme and protection against the other Dagannoth Kings.
Limit how many kings can attack you together, then kill Supreme with melee.
Accumulate 10 kills; do not accidentally fight Prime with melee or Rex with ranged.

tasks.name: Dagannoth Supreme Adept
steps: Take melee for Supreme, with food and prayer restoration for the kings' room.
Control your position to reduce simultaneous attacks and finish Supreme with melee.
Reach 25 total Supreme kills; banking between trips is allowed.

tasks.name: Death to the Archer King
steps: Keep Prime and Rex alive while you lower Supreme's health.
Draw attacks from both other kings and protect against the most dangerous incoming attacks.
Finish Supreme while Prime and Rex are both attacking you; safespotting either away breaks the required setup.

tasks.name: Rapid Succession
steps: Bring melee for Supreme, ranged for Prime and magic for Rex; lower all three to finishing-hit health.
Stop attacking a king before it dies until the other two are also ready.
Finish all three within 9 seconds of the first death, switching styles promptly.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Veteran
steps: Enter normal Theatre of Blood with a team and supplies for all six rooms.
Assign Nylocas styles and communicate Sotetseg's maze and Verzik mechanics.
Complete 25 raids; failed runs do not add a completion.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Master
steps: Run normal Theatre with reliable room roles and all three attack styles available.
Conserve supplies by handling adds and movement mechanics before continuing boss damage.
Accumulate 75 raid completions; this task has no speed or deathless restriction.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood Grandmaster
steps: Choose a consistent normal Theatre team and prepare supplies for the whole raid.
Keep roles clear for add control, the maze and Verzik so runs finish reliably.
Reach 150 full completions.

tasks.name: Two-Down
steps: Prepare damage boosts and special attacks before entering Bloat's room.
Stay out of his sight while he walks, then attack during his first and second shutdowns.
Finish him before the third shutdown begins; leave his stomp area as each attack window ends.

tasks.name: Pop It
steps: Tell the team not to freeze any Nylocas during Verzik.
Move away from approaching explosive Nylocas and handle them without allowing anyone to take their damage.
Finish Verzik with no frozen Nylocas and no team member damaged by one.

tasks.name: A Timely Snack
steps: Agree who will receive Sotetseg's large ball attacks and keep the team away from the target.
Prepare the target's health and timed healing for at least three unshared balls; ordinary stacking to split them fails this task.
Complete the fight with no deaths, including during the mazes.

tasks.name: Perfect Theatre
steps: Agree a deathless normal Theatre run with all six room-perfection conditions before starting.
Prevent Maiden's blood/heals, Bloat's flies/debris/stomp and wrong-style Nylocas hits; preserve every pillar.
Run Sotetseg's maze and prayers cleanly, prevent Xarpus damage/excess exhumed heals, and avoid prohibited Verzik damage.
Every player must satisfy all six perfect tasks in this one run; any death fails it.

tasks.name: Perfect Maiden
steps: Protect against Maiden's attacks and move off blood trails before they damage anyone.
Freeze and kill Matomenos before they reach Maiden and heal her.
Keep every teammate clear of bloodspawn projectiles and trails until Maiden dies.

tasks.name: Perfect Bloat
steps: Enter Bloat's room only when his direction and line of sight are safe for the team.
Move around the central obstacle out of his sight and dodge falling body parts.
Attack during shutdowns, then retreat before the stomp; nobody may take flies, debris or stomp damage.

tasks.name: Perfect Nylocas
steps: Assign melee, ranged and magic roles; attack each Nylocas only with its matching colour/style.
Kill pillar attackers promptly so no pillar collapses.
For Vasilias, switch weapon and protection prayer to its current colour before every attack; every teammate must avoid wrong-style hits and off-prayer damage.

tasks.name: Perfect Sotetseg
steps: Protect against Sotetseg's incoming style and move clear of the tornado.
Have the selected player communicate the maze route and have everyone follow its safe tiles.
Finish with no team member taking off-prayer damage or stepping on an incorrect maze tile.

tasks.name: Perfect Xarpus
steps: Cover exhumeds during Xarpus's opening phase so none heals him more than twice.
During the poison phase, move away from targeted tiles without stepping into existing pools.
After he screeches, stop attacking whenever he looks toward you; nobody may take Xarpus damage.

tasks.name: Perfect Verzik
steps: Use pillars and Dawnbringer safely during Verzik's first phase, then dodge the second phase's bounce and projectiles.
Handle Nylocas, lightning, webs, yellow attacks and tornadoes without anyone taking their damage.
In spider form, protect correctly against regular magic/ranged attacks; only that correctly protected regular damage is allowed.

tasks.name: Can't Drain This
steps: Agree that every teammate disables all prayers before Maiden starts; do not use quick prayers or offensive prayers.
Avoid blood trails, kill healing Nylocas and use food to sustain the fight.
Finish without any teammate losing a prayer point; drinking a restore after a loss does not undo the failure.

tasks.name: Can You Dance?
steps: Give every teammate a melee weapon before Xarpus; remove ranged/magic weapons from the planned switches.
Cover exhumeds, then attack with melee while moving away from poison tiles.
Stop attacking when he looks toward you in the final phase; nobody may use a ranged or magic weapon.

tasks.name: Morytania Only
steps: Check the whole team's weapon loadouts: only Barrows weapons may be equipped, with Dawnbringer the sole exception.
Bring suitable Barrows weapons for all Nylocas colours; never equip an ordinary staff or special-attack weapon by habit.
Complete the entire normal Theatre with the restriction maintained in every room.

tasks.name: Back in My Day...
steps: Have every teammate bank their Scythe of Vitur before entering normal Theatre.
Use other melee weapons and the usual ranged/magic switches as required by the rooms.
Finish the full raid without anyone ever equipping a scythe.

tasks.name: Theatre (Duo) Speed-Runner
steps: Start normal Theatre as a duo and assign add, maze and Verzik responsibilities before entry.
Use attack windows fully and move between rooms without idle inventory management.
Complete the raid in less than 26 minutes; avoid deaths and mechanics that prolong phases.

tasks.name: Theatre (Trio) Speed-Chaser
steps: Form a normal Theatre trio with fixed Nylocas roles and coordinated specials.
Keep room transitions quick and handle healing adds immediately.
Finish in less than 20 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre (Trio) Speed-Runner
steps: Enter normal Theatre as a trio with roles and burst-damage plans agreed.
Avoid lost attacks during Bloat shutdowns, Nylocas changes and Verzik phases.
Complete in less than 17 minutes 30 seconds, including efficient room transitions.

tasks.name: Theatre (4-Scale) Speed-Chaser
steps: Use a four-player normal Theatre team with assigned styles and mechanics roles.
Coordinate damage and add control so no room waits on one unfinished mechanic.
Finish in less than 17 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre (4-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Start a four-player normal Theatre run with a rehearsed room plan.
Keep attack windows busy and minimise time spent moving or reorganising supplies.
Complete in less than 15 minutes; recoverable mistakes can still cost the time target.

tasks.name: Theatre (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
steps: Form a five-player normal Theatre team and divide Nylocas/add responsibilities.
Use coordinated specials and prompt room transitions to maintain the pace.
Finish in less than 16 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare a five-player normal Theatre run with fixed responsibilities and efficient switches.
Keep everyone attacking through safe damage windows and move immediately after each room.
Complete in less than 14 minutes 15 seconds.

tasks.name: Thermonuclear Veteran
steps: Enter the Smoke Devil Dungeon with the Slayer level and active assignment needed for repeated Thermonuclear kills; wear a facemask or Slayer helmet.
Use your strongest effective attacks and sustain the damage with food; protection prayers do not fully prevent his attacks.
Accumulate 20 kills, restocking between trips as needed.

tasks.name: Hazard Prevention
steps: Prepare burst damage, then attack and step underneath Thermonuclear Smoke Devil between your attacks to limit his attack opportunities.
Keep the movement cycle going until he dies; anyone being hit fails the attempt, so do not rely on protection prayers alone.

tasks.name: Spec'd Out
steps: Disable auto-retaliate and prepare enough special-attack weapons/energy for the kill.
Deal every damaging attack with a weapon special; stop attacking when energy runs out and let it regenerate.
Keep ordinary attacks and passive damage out of the attempt until Thermonuclear Smoke Devil dies.

tasks.name: Venenatis Adept
steps: Prepare a crush weapon, supplies and an escape plan before entering Venenatis's Wilderness lair.
Change protection prayers for her ranged/magic attacks, clear spiderlings and move out of webs.
Reach 10 Venenatis kills; her room is dangerous Wilderness multicombat, so bank loot regularly.

tasks.name: Venenatis Veteran
steps: Bring crush gear and supplies to Venenatis's Wilderness lair.
Handle her alternating ranged/magic attacks, remove spiderlings and avoid damaging webs.
Accumulate 20 kills; bank between trips to limit carried loot and supplies at risk.

tasks.name: Vet'ion Adept
steps: Use a crush weapon against Vet'ion and move out of the lightning markers and shield attacks.
Kill both summoned hellhounds whenever they make Vet'ion immune, then continue through his second form.
Reach 10 kills; protection prayers do not replace dodging the lightning.

tasks.name: Vet'eran
steps: Fight Vet'ion with crush, avoiding lightning and his shield attack in both forms.
Switch to his hellhounds whenever they grant him immunity, then return to the boss.
Accumulate 20 kills, banking between trips through his Wilderness lair.

tasks.name: Vorkath Veteran
steps: Prepare dragonfire and venom protection and a way to kill the zombified spawn.
Move away from the large fireball, keep walking on clear tiles during acid, and destroy each spawn promptly.
Accumulate 50 Vorkath kills; bank whenever needed.

tasks.name: Vorkath Master
steps: Take dragonfire/venom protection, food and runes for Crumble Undead or another spawn-killing method.
Dodge the large fireball and keep moving during acid specials.
Reach 100 total kills with consistent safe mechanics rather than forcing long trips.

tasks.name: The Walk
steps: Turn run off and find a clear line of tiles when Vorkath starts his acid special.
Use a fast weapon and a practiced attack-walk cycle to attack without pausing for the rapid fireballs.
Land 12 hits during the acid special without stepping on acid or being hit by rapid fire.

tasks.name: Zombie Destroyer
steps: Bring a weapon or spell capable of quickly killing the zombified spawn; do not use Crumble Undead.
When Vorkath freezes you, switch to the spawn and kill it before it reaches you.
Focus on the spawn rather than Vorkath until it is dead.

tasks.name: Dodging the Dragon
steps: Pack supplies and protection for five kills in one visit; do not leave Vorkath's area between them.
Dodge every large fireball, keep moving through clear acid tiles and kill each zombified spawn before it explodes.
Finish five consecutive kills with no damage from his special attacks.

tasks.name: Stick 'em With the Pointy End
steps: Equip a melee weapon for all damage dealt to Vorkath and prepare dragonfire/venom protection.
Use melee for the boss throughout the kill; handle acid and large fireballs with movement.
Crumble Undead can still be used on the separate zombified spawn; do not accidentally cast it or another spell at Vorkath.

tasks.name: Faithless Encounter
steps: Disable every prayer before waking Vorkath; prepare sufficient dragonfire protection and food for an unprotected fight.
Dodge fireballs and acid, and kill zombified spawns promptly.
Finish without losing any prayer points; restoring drained points afterward does not repair a failed attempt.

tasks.name: The Fremennik Way
steps: Remove your weapon and prepare melee boosts, protection and ample healing for a long unarmed fight.
Damage Vorkath only with your fists; avoid damaging specials, recoil and thralls.
Keep dodging acid/fireballs and use Crumble Undead on the separate spawn while completing the fist-only boss kill.

tasks.name: Vorkath Speed-Chaser
steps: Prepare boosts, dragonfire/venom protection and specials before waking Vorkath.
Keep attacks going between specials and kill zombified spawns promptly so they do not delay damage.
Finish the kill in less than 1 minute 15 seconds.

tasks.name: Vorkath Speed-Runner
steps: Start fully prepared with boosts and the most effective damage setup available.
Minimise missed attacks, destroy spawns promptly and maintain a safe attack-walk cycle during acid if practised.
Finish in less than 54 seconds; repeat attempts when low damage makes the timer unattainable.

tasks.name: Extended Encounter
steps: Pack enough food, prayer restoration and dragonfire/venom protection for ten kills before entering.
Avoid unnecessary special-attack damage and track remaining supplies after each kill.
Kill Vorkath ten times without leaving his area; a bank trip breaks this attempt.

tasks.name: Wintertodt Novice
steps: Take an axe, tinderbox, hammer and warm clothing to Wintertodt; manage your warmth with available healing.
Chop bruma roots, feed the brazier and repair or relight it when needed.
Stay until Wintertodt is subdued five times.

tasks.name: Wintertodt Champion
steps: Prepare warm equipment and tools for chopping, lighting and repairing braziers.
Feed roots or kindling to working braziers and keep your warmth high enough to survive.
Complete ten Wintertodt subdues; they need not be in a single visit.

tasks.name: Mummy!
steps: Collect a rejuvenation potion for the Wintertodt arena.
Wait until a pyromancer falls, then use the potion on that fallen pyromancer.
Healing one that is still standing does not satisfy this particular task.

tasks.name: Handyman
steps: Bring or collect a hammer in the Wintertodt arena.
When a brazier is destroyed, click it to repair the broken structure.
Relighting an intact brazier is a different action and does not complete this repair task.

tasks.name: Can We Fix It?
steps: Watch the state of all four braziers while the Wintertodt fight runs.
Repair broken braziers promptly so at least one is never broken.
Stay through the subdue without all four being broken simultaneously.

tasks.name: Leaving No One Behind
steps: Prepare rejuvenation potions and watch every pyromancer's health.
Heal weakened pyromancers before they fall; coordinate coverage with other players.
Subdue Wintertodt without any pyromancer falling at any point.

tasks.name: Cosy
steps: Equip four items recognised as warm clothing before starting Wintertodt.
Keep all four equipped while feeding and maintaining the brazier.
Finish a subdue without replacing a warm piece with an unrecognised item.

tasks.name: Why Fletch?
steps: Choose a slower Wintertodt game and fletch roots into kindling for more points per inventory.
Feed braziers, repair/relight them and heal pyromancers while managing your warmth.
Reach at least 3000 points in that one fight before Wintertodt is subdued.

tasks.name: A Slithery Encounter
steps: Enter Karuulm Slayer Dungeon with 62 Slayer; wear boots of stone, brimstone or granite unless you have the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary exemption.
Attack a Wyrm with ranged from outside melee distance, use Protect from Magic if available and finish one kill.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM Master
steps: Select Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode and prepare all three attack styles and supplies for its fixed room route.
Handle the stronger combat rooms and finish Olm rather than leaving after an individual room.
Accumulate ten Challenge Mode completions.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM Grandmaster
steps: Enter Chambers of Xeric Challenge Mode with a repeatable room plan and sufficient supplies.
Assign team jobs for combat rooms and Olm, or use your established solo route.
Finish 25 Challenge Mode raids; ordinary Chambers completions do not count.

tasks.name: Immortal Raid Team
steps: Enter Chambers Challenge Mode with a team that has agreed on safe room roles and sufficient healing.
Prepare extra supplies before Olm and protect/move correctly through his specials.
Complete the entire raid without any teammate dying; a death in an earlier room also fails it.

tasks.name: Immortal Raider
steps: Start Chambers Challenge Mode alone and bring equipment for the full fixed room route.
Prepare enough healing and prayer supplies before Olm rather than rushing into his chamber.
Complete the solo raid without dying anywhere.

tasks.name: Dust Seeker
steps: Start Challenge Mode and check the target time shown for your team size.
Assign room and Olm responsibilities and prepare supplies without unnecessary delays.
Finish the raid before the displayed target; the qualifying time depends on scale.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Chaser
steps: Start a solo Chambers Challenge Mode run and plan the fixed route and supply preparation.
Use effective styles in each room and keep Olm attacks going while handling specials.
Complete the full solo raid in less than 45 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Solo) Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare a solo Challenge Mode route with efficient gear changes and minimal supply-preparation time.
Avoid extra Tekton/Vasa cycles and minimise lost attacks at Olm.
Finish in less than 38 minutes 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
steps: Form a five-player Chambers Challenge Mode team and assign combat-room, supply and Olm roles.
Coordinate damage and add control; move together to the next room promptly.
Finish the five-player raid in less than 30 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Enter Chambers Challenge Mode with five players and a rehearsed room route.
Share preparation jobs and coordinate burst damage so bosses do not gain extra healing cycles.
Finish in less than 25 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Trio) Speed-Chaser
steps: Start a trio Chambers Challenge Mode run with fixed room and Olm responsibilities.
Keep supply preparation short and avoid waiting on an unfinished combat mechanic.
Complete the trio raid in less than 35 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric: CM (Trio) Speed-Runner
steps: Form a trio for Chambers Challenge Mode and agree efficient room/supply roles before entry.
Maintain damage during safe windows and move straight through the fixed route.
Finish in less than 27 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric Veteran
steps: Prepare all three attack styles and the tools needed for Chambers rooms.
Clear the selected route, gather sufficient supplies and defeat Great Olm.
Accumulate 25 complete normal Chambers raids.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric Master
steps: Choose normal Chambers layouts you can clear consistently and take equipment for every room in the route.
Prepare supplies before Olm and handle his specials without forcing unsafe damage.
Reach 75 raid completions; individual room kills do not count as a raid.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric Grandmaster
steps: Use a reliable normal Chambers solo route or team with clear room responsibilities.
Conserve supplies and finish Olm on each run before leaving.
Accumulate 150 full raid completions.

tasks.name: Perfectly Balanced
steps: Identify the three Vanguards and use the effective attack style for each.
Rotate targets to keep their health bars close together rather than bursting one down first.
Finish all three without their health difference causing a reset; stop high-damage attacks when one falls too far behind.

tasks.name: Together We'll Fall
steps: Lower all three Vanguards together while keeping their health balanced to avoid resets.
Bring each to finishing-hit health before killing the first.
Kill the other two within 10 seconds of the first death; coordinate target changes with teammates.

tasks.name: No Time for Death
steps: Leave every Deathly Mage and Ranger alive and prepare enough health to cross the tightrope under attack.
Cross, collect the keystone and use it to open the barrier.
Do not attack the enemies or leave passive damage on them; crossing with them alive can deal heavy damage at once.

tasks.name: Putting It Olm on the Line
steps: Start a solo Chambers raid with enough scoring rooms to exceed 40,000 points.
Complete scoring combat and puzzle actions and avoid deaths, which remove points.
Check your personal points before finishing Olm and complete the raid above 40,000.

tasks.name: A Not So Special Lizard
steps: Run Chambers solo and enter Olm's penultimate hand phase with a practised special-skipping movement cycle.
For a four-tick melee weapon, maintain the 4:1 head-turn cycle so Crystal Burst, lightning, teleports and left-hand healing never occur.
Finish both hands without breaking the cycle; rushing damage into his head does not skip this hand phase.

tasks.name: Mutta-diet
steps: Bring an axe into the Muttadile room and cut down the meat tree before either Muttadile can heal from it.
Control their attacks while chopping, then kill the baby and adult.
Neither may recover hitpoints from the tree during the encounter.

tasks.name: Redemption Enthusiast
steps: Keep Vespula airborne and direct your damage into the Abyssal Portal.
Manage your health, prayer and nearby threats without damaging Vespula enough to make her land.
Destroy the portal while she remains airborne; killing Vespula first does not qualify.

tasks.name: Stop Drop and Roll
steps: Prepare ranged damage for Vasa and an effective melee switch for the crystal he targets.
Break that crystal promptly so he returns to the room, then resume damage immediately.
Kill Vasa before his second teleport attack; slow crystal kills lose the required window.

tasks.name: Anvil No More
steps: Prepare melee damage and defence-reducing specials before engaging Tekton.
Keep damage going during his first attack window and move away from his marked attacks.
Finish before his second return to the anvil after the fight starts; extra anvil cycles fail the task.

tasks.name: Dancing with Statues
steps: Equip a pickaxe on a crush attack style to damage a Stone Guardian.
Move away from falling-rock shadows while contributing enough damage for kill-credit.
Finish your credited Guardian kill without taking falling-rock damage.

tasks.name: Undying Raid Team
steps: Agree a deathless normal Chambers run with the whole team before starting.
Handle combat rooms safely and prepare sufficient supplies before Olm.
Complete the raid with no deaths from any player, including earlier rooms.

tasks.name: Undying Raider
steps: Start a normal Chambers raid alone with gear and supplies appropriate for the selected rooms.
Prepare extra healing before Olm and prioritise survival through his specials.
Complete the entire solo raid without dying.

tasks.name: Shayzien Specialist
steps: Take protection against Shaman poison, such as full tier-five Shayzien armour, and attack from outside melee range.
Protect against ranged attacks; move away from jumps and exploding spawns from every Shaman in the room.
Receive kill-credit for one Shaman without taking damage from any of them.

tasks.name: Playing with Lasers
steps: Before activating the first crystal, plan each orb path and place the required crabs.
Use melee to colour a crab red, magic for blue and ranged for green; set the colour before the orb reaches it.
After the first activation, direct every orb into a remaining crystal; avoid intercepting it or sending it through an incompatible crab.

tasks.name: Cryo No More
steps: Feed and light the braziers to make the Ice Demon attackable; prepare a fire spell or another damage weapon.
Move clear of the targeted ice/snowball impact area after every attack; protection prayer alone does not remove its damage.
Receive kill-credit while taking no damage during the encounter.

tasks.name: Perfect Olm (Solo)
steps: Run Olm solo and move clear of crystal bursts/bombs, fire walls and teleport damage; use the correct protection for prayer orbs.
Cover healing pools, avoid repeated damage from the same acid pool and finish both hands close together so neither regenerates.
Finish the head while maintaining all these conditions throughout the kill.

tasks.name: Perfect Olm (Trio)
steps: Enter Olm as a trio and assign hand/head responsibilities and calls for teleports, fire and orbs.
Keep every player clear of crystal bursts/bombs and damaging walls; cover healing pools and avoid repeated damage from the same acid pool.
Finish both hands close together to prevent regeneration, then finish the head with no listed failure by anyone.

tasks.name: Blind Spot
steps: Use effective melee attacks against Tekton and move out of his melee swings instead of relying on prayer to prevent all damage.
Dodge the marked projectiles when he returns to his anvil.
Finish the kill without taking any damage; an unprotected hit or anvil projectile ruins the attempt.

tasks.name: Blizzard Dodger
steps: Keep Protect from Missiles disabled throughout the Ice Demon encounter.
Light/feed the braziers, then move out of every targeted snowball or ice impact area.
Receive kill-credit without ever activating that forbidden prayer; other prayers remain available.

tasks.name: Kill It with Fire
steps: Bring runes and a suitable standard-spellbook fire spell into the Ice Demon room.
Lower his health, then stop other damage and cast the fire spell for the finishing blow.
Do not let a weapon hit or thrall finish him before the fire spell lands.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Chaser
steps: Start normal Chambers solo and choose a route you can clear quickly with little preparation.
Keep the effective damage style ready for every room and minimise lost attacks at Olm.
Complete the full raid in less than 21 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Solo) Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare a fast solo Chambers layout and an efficient supply plan before the run.
Avoid prolonged boss cycles, unnecessary backtracking and downtime during Olm.
Finish in less than 17 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Chaser
steps: Enter normal Chambers with five players and divide room, supply and Olm jobs.
Coordinate damage so no room stalls on unfinished adds or crystals.
Complete the five-player raid in less than 15 minutes.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Start a five-player normal Chambers run with a rehearsed route and supply plan.
Share preparation work and keep everyone attacking during safe boss windows.
Finish in less than 12 minutes 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Chaser
steps: Form a normal Chambers trio with clear room and Olm roles.
Keep preparation and transitions short; coordinate damage on targets that delay room completion.
Finish the trio raid in less than 16 minutes 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Chambers of Xeric (Trio) Speed-Runner
steps: Start normal Chambers as a trio with an efficient layout and rehearsed damage plan.
Minimise supply preparation, backtracking and missed Olm attacks.
Complete the raid in less than 14 minutes 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Zalcano Veteran
steps: Bring a pickaxe to Zalcano, mine tephra, refine it and imbue it at the room's stations.
Throw imbued tephra to break her armour, then mine her while she is vulnerable.
Dodge rocks and damaging symbols while accumulating 25 kills.

tasks.name: Perfect Zalcano
steps: Prepare supplies for five Zalcano kills without leaving the chamber.
Move off falling-rock shadows, away from exploding mining rocks and clear of Zalcano as she powers up.
Never stand in a red symbol and complete five consecutive kills without any listed damage or an exit.

tasks.name: Team Player
steps: Watch for a golem during Zalcano's armoured phase and attack it before it reaches her.
Collect the imbued tephra it drops; this pickup is the task's objective.

tasks.name: The Spurned Hero
steps: During Zalcano's armour phase, obtain and throw imbued tephra efficiently; use safe blue symbols when possible.
Mine her promptly during each vulnerable phase.
Get the most damage of any player when she dies; a solo kill removes competition but still requires completing the fight.

tasks.name: K'ril Tsutsaroth Adept
steps: Bring a damage setup, protection and healing for K'ril and his three bodyguards.
Handle the boss and minions, clear the room after each kill and restock when necessary.
Accumulate 50 kills; god-aligned gear does not make his boss-room bodyguards harmless.

tasks.name: K'ril Tsutsaroth Veteran
steps: Prepare a repeatable K'ril method and supplies for damage from the boss and bodyguards.
Clear minions between boss respawns and keep health/prayer high enough for the next kill.
Reach 100 total kills, banking between trips as needed.

tasks.name: Yarr No More
steps: Use a method that avoids K'ril's prayer-smashing special, such as keeping Protect from Melee off and sustaining damage safely.
Maintain damage and receive kill-credit before he uses the special.
If the special occurs, the attempt has failed; food and positioning remain necessary without melee protection.

tasks.name: Demonic Showdown
steps: Lower K'ril's health while controlling the bodyguards, then kill all three bodyguards.
Finish K'ril before any bodyguard respawns.
Check every bodyguard is dead at the killing blow; merely damaging all three does not qualify.

tasks.name: The Bane of Demons
steps: Rent a private K'ril instance and bring the runes/spellbook for demonbane spells.
Disable auto-retaliate and damage K'ril only with demonbane spells; do not use a normal staff attack or weapon special.
Finish the kill within that private instance while maintaining the spell restriction.

tasks.name: Demonic Defence
steps: Start a private K'ril instance with a ranged or magic method that keeps you outside his melee reach.
Keep moving on the method's route while attacking, handling bodyguards separately.
Kill K'ril without any of his melee hits landing; protection prayers alone do not replace the required avoidance.

tasks.name: Demon Whisperer
steps: Use a private K'ril instance and a practised method for separating bodyguard attacks and switching protection prayers.
Handle all three bodyguards while maintaining boss damage and safe positioning.
Finish without being hit by any bodyguard; a Zamorak item does not stop them attacking inside the boss room.

tasks.name: Demonbane Weaponry II
steps: Bring a demonbane weapon you can wield and keep it ready for the finish.
Lower K'ril's health with your normal method, then stop other damage and equip the demonbane weapon.
Land the killing blow with that weapon before a thrall or another attack finishes him.

tasks.name: Ash Collector
steps: Pack enough healing, prayer restoration and a sustainable damage method before renting a private K'ril instance.
Kill the bodyguards between respawns and conserve supplies across twenty boss kills.
Remain inside the room for all twenty kills; leaving to bank breaks the attempt.

tasks.name: Half-Way There
steps: Progress through Inferno waves until a Jal-Zek mage appears.
Use Protect from Magic against its attacks while managing the other wave enemies.
Kill one Jal-Zek; completing the whole Inferno is not required for this task.

tasks.name: Inferno Grandmaster
steps: Prepare a reliable Inferno setup with supplies for the waves and Zuk.
Preserve pillars during the waves, then stay behind Zuk's moving shield and handle the sets/Jad/healers.
Accumulate five full Inferno completions.

tasks.name: The Floor Is Lava
steps: Prioritise each Jal-ImKot melee enemy before it has time to dig to you.
Kill it promptly or manage its access to you instead of leaving it trapped behind a pillar for a long time.
Complete the entire Inferno and kill Zuk without any Jal-ImKot digging on any wave.

tasks.name: Playing with Jads
steps: During triple Jad, keep the other two alive while bringing them close to finishing-hit health.
Once the first Jad dies, kill the remaining two within 30 seconds.
Continue switching protection prayers and managing healers; taking unprotected Jad attacks to gain damage is unsafe.

tasks.name: No Luck Required
steps: Stay inside Zuk's moving shield protection whenever he can attack.
Protect correctly against every JalTok-Jad attack while still following the shield.
Finish Zuk without him attacking you and without taking damage from any Jad in the run.

tasks.name: Nibblers, Begone!
steps: Kill the nibblers attacking pillars promptly at the start of each Inferno wave.
Protect and reposition against the other enemies without letting nibblers destroy a pillar.
Reach wave 67 with the pillars preserved, then finish Zuk.

tasks.name: Wasn't Even Close
steps: Start the Inferno with supplies to maintain a health buffer above 50.
Heal before incoming damage could drop your health below 50 rather than waiting for a low-health warning.
Complete every wave and kill Zuk without ever crossing below the threshold.

tasks.name: Budget Setup
steps: Bank the Twisted bow before entering the Inferno and prepare other ranged weapons for Jad/Zuk.
Complete the waves using your alternative setup and manage pillar enemies normally.
Finish Zuk without equipping a Twisted bow anywhere in the Inferno.

tasks.name: Nibbler Chaser
steps: Bring chinchompas to hit grouped nibblers and use ranged or melee weapons for the other wave enemies.
Do not cast offensive, healing or utility spells during any wave; use supplies and prayer for sustain.
Complete the Inferno and kill Zuk without casting a magic spell.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on II
steps: Keep ranged and magic weapons unequipped through waves 1-68; use melee weapons and manually cast spells for nibblers without a staff or wand.
Remove enough negative-magic armour for manual spells to land, and manage Jad positioning and overhead prayers without a forbidden weapon.
Wait until Zuk's wave-69 cutscene starts, then equip your ranged weapon and finish Zuk.

tasks.name: Jad? What Are You Doing Here?
steps: When the JalTok-Jad spawns during Zuk, leave it alive and direct damage into Zuk.
Protect against that Jad's attacks while keeping inside the moving shield.
Finish Zuk without killing the wave-69 Jad; avoid stray attacks that could finish it.

tasks.name: Inferno Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare an efficient Inferno wave plan and damage setup before starting.
Clear nibblers and dangerous wave enemies promptly without unnecessary waiting, then handle Zuk's sets and healers efficiently.
Complete the entire Inferno in less than 65 minutes while preserving safe prayers and shield movement.

tasks.name: Tempoross Novice
steps: Take a harpoon, rope and buckets to Tempoross; fish harpoonfish and load the ship's cannons.
When his energy is depleted, fish the spirit pool to reduce his essence.
Accumulate five subdues while avoiding fire, waves and torrent attacks.

tasks.name: Tempoross Champion
steps: Prepare Tempoross tools, fish harpoonfish and use cannons to drain his energy.
Fish the spirit pool during vulnerability and repeat the cycle until he is subdued.
Complete ten subdues; separate fights count toward the total.

tasks.name: Dress Like You Mean It
steps: Equip all four pieces of a recognised angler or spirit angler outfit before the fight.
Fish, load cannons and fish the spirit pool while keeping the complete outfit on.
Finish the Tempoross subdue wearing the full set.

tasks.name: Master of Buckets
steps: Fill buckets at a water pump and watch where lightning starts fires.
Use water on at least five separate fires yourself during one fight.
Refill buckets as needed; another player's extinguishes do not add to your five.

tasks.name: Calm Before the Storm
steps: Carry a hammer and watch a mast or totem pole for damage during Tempoross.
Click the damaged structure to repair it before another player does.
Repairing either kind of structure completes the task.

tasks.name: Why Cook?
steps: Use a long or solo Tempoross fight to build personal points with cooked fish, extinguishes and repairs.
Watch the points/reward-permit display and continue scoring before the final subdue.
Finish that single fight with ten reward permits awarded; permits from previous games do not count.

tasks.name: The Lone Angler
steps: Enter a Tempoross fight alone and keep water and tethering equipment ready.
Move out of fire and cannon torrents, and tether to a mast or totem before each wave.
Subdue Tempoross without being hit by any fire, torrent or wave.

tasks.name: Fire in the Hole!
steps: Load harpoonfish into each of the two cannons on the first ship.
Cross to the other ship and load both of its cannons as well.
Personally use all four cannons so attacks come from both sides; one cannon on each ship is insufficient.

tasks.name: The II Jad Challenge
steps: Select TzHaar-Ket-Rak's second challenge with supplies and a weapon ready for two Jads.
Read each Jad's attack animation and switch overhead prayers for their staggered attacks.
Kill both, managing their healers without missing the next protection switch.

tasks.name: The IV Jad Challenge
steps: Start the fourth TzHaar-Ket-Rak challenge, ready to track four Jads' attack animations.
Protect against each staggered attack and focus damage on one Jad at a time to reduce the pressure.
Handle healers while keeping the prayer sequence intact and complete the challenge.

tasks.name: The VI Jad Challenge
steps: Select the sixth challenge and prepare to follow six Jads' staggered attack animations.
Keep the correct overhead for every incoming attack; focus one Jad and control its healers.
Kill all six without letting damage actions distract you from the next prayer switch.

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Trialist
steps: Select the first challenge with boosts and specials ready before the fight.
Attack the single Jad continuously between prayer switches and control healers promptly.
Complete the challenge in less than 45 seconds.

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Chaser
steps: Select the third TzHaar-Ket-Rak challenge with boosts and supplies ready.
Track the three Jads' staggered attacks while focusing one down and handling its healers.
Finish the challenge in less than 3 minutes; prayer switches must continue during damage actions.

tasks.name: TzHaar-Ket-Rak's Speed-Runner
steps: Start the fifth challenge and prepare to follow five staggered Jad attack animations.
Focus one Jad at a time, control its healers and keep damage going between overhead switches.
Complete the challenge in less than 5 minutes.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on III
steps: Select the second challenge with melee weapons only for damaging the Jads.
Position next to your target while still reading both Jads' attack animations and switching prayers.
Finish both with melee; do not use a ranged/magic switch to pull healers by habit.

tasks.name: Facing Jad Head-on IV
steps: Enter the fourth challenge with a melee-only damage setup.
Move into melee reach of one Jad at a time and protect correctly against the four staggered attack animations.
Kill all four using only melee while handling healers without forbidden attacks.

tasks.name: Supplies? Who Needs 'em?
steps: Equip your weapon, armour and any required ammunition, then empty every inventory slot before the third challenge.
Do not pick up or carry supplies during the fight.
Defeat the three Jads by maintaining protection prayers and using your equipped setup; inventory food or a spare weapon fails the restriction.

tasks.name: It Wasn't a Fluke
steps: Prepare for both the fifth and sixth Jad challenges before beginning the sequence.
Complete challenge five, then challenge six without a failed attempt between them.
Continue tracking staggered attacks and handling healers in both fights; one successful challenge by itself is insufficient.

tasks.name: Multi-Style Specialist
steps: Bring melee, ranged and magic weapons into the third challenge and assign one style to each Jad.
Damage the first Jad only with its assigned style, then change styles for each remaining Jad.
Complete all three with a different style per Jad while maintaining the overhead prayer sequence.

tasks.name: Stop Right There!
steps: Enter Hard Mode Theatre and assign someone to kill Maiden's bloodspawns promptly.
Prioritise those bloodspawns before they leave repeated trails; continue controlling the healing Matomenos.
Finish Maiden with no more than 15 blood trails created; leaving spawns alive loses the allowance quickly.

tasks.name: Personal Space
steps: Start Hard Mode Bloat with at least three people in the room and assign separate movement lanes/attack tiles.
Keep checking teammate positions while following Bloat and dodging debris.
Finish with nobody standing on another player at any point, including shutdown attack windows.

tasks.name: Royal Affairs
steps: In Hard Mode Nylocas, prepare the effective attack style as each Prinkipas appears.
Have the team focus it immediately and kill it before its first style change.
Repeat for every Prinkipas before finishing the room; switching after it changes does not rescue the task.

tasks.name: Harder Mode I
steps: Agree that every Sotetseg ball target handles the ball alone; keep other players away and prepare timed healing.
Protect correctly against all other attacks and follow every maze tile accurately.
Finish Hard Mode Sotetseg with no shared balls, deaths, other attack damage or incorrect maze steps by anyone.

tasks.name: Harder Mode II
steps: In Hard Mode Xarpus, leave the exhumeds uncovered until they heal him all the way to full health.
After that, dodge all poison attacks and stop attacking whenever he looks toward you.
Finish the fight without anyone taking damage; preventing his initial healing fails this task.

tasks.name: Nylo Sniper
steps: In Hard Mode Verzik, have everyone keep clear of approaching Nylocas and attack them from a safe distance.
Avoid walking next to one while moving between boss attacks or specials.
Finish Verzik without any teammate triggering a Nylocas explosion by proximity.

tasks.name: Team Work Makes the Dream Work
steps: Keep at least two players alive until Hard Mode Verzik uses a yellow power blast while tornadoes are active.
Have every player reach a safe yellow position while keeping clear of their chasing tornado.
Everyone must survive that blast without damage; attempting it with only one survivor does not qualify.

tasks.name: Harder Mode III
steps: Tell the entire team to switch to ranged or magic before Hard Mode Verzik enters phase three.
Never attack her with a melee weapon during that phase, including weapon specials.
Handle webs, yellows and tornadoes while finishing the fight with allowed styles.

tasks.name: Pack Like a Yak
steps: Pack supplies for the entire Hard Mode Theatre raid and tell everyone to avoid purchasing from any supply chest.
Handle each room cleanly with no deaths and keep transitions/preparation quick.
Finish inside the displayed challenge time with zero purchases and zero deaths by the whole team.

tasks.name: Hard Mode? Completed It
steps: Start Hard Mode Theatre and check the challenge time for the chosen team scale.
Assign room responsibilities and keep boss damage and room transitions efficient.
Complete the raid within that challenge time; the relevant target depends on scale.

tasks.name: Theatre: HM (Trio) Speed-Runner
steps: Form a trio for Hard Mode Theatre with rehearsed add, maze and Verzik roles.
Maintain damage in safe windows and minimise idle time between rooms.
Finish with an overall time under 23 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre: HM (4-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Enter Hard Mode Theatre with four players and agree room responsibilities before starting.
Coordinate specials and add control, then move promptly after each room.
Complete the raid with an overall time under 21 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre: HM (5-Scale) Speed-Runner
steps: Prepare a five-player Hard Mode Theatre team and efficient plans for all six rooms.
Keep damage windows busy and eliminate delays from adds, healing mechanics and transitions.
Finish with an overall time under 19 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood: HM Grandmaster
steps: Enter Hard Mode Theatre with supplies and a team prepared for its additional room mechanics.
Complete all six rooms and defeat Verzik before leaving.
Accumulate 50 Hard Mode completions; normal and Entry Mode runs do not count.

tasks.name: Anticoagulants
steps: Start Entry Mode Maiden and watch for each bloodspawn appearing in the arena.
Stop boss damage when necessary and kill each spawn immediately.
Defeat Maiden without any bloodspawn surviving longer than 10 seconds.

tasks.name: Appropriate Tools
steps: Have every teammate equip a salve amulet before entering Entry Mode Bloat.
Keep the amulet equipped while following him safely and attacking during shutdowns.
Finish Bloat with every teammate meeting the equipment condition.

tasks.name: They Won't Expect This
steps: After Entry Mode Maiden, walk around to Bloat's opposite entrance before entering his room.
Enter from that far side rather than the normal forward entrance.
Check Bloat's position first so the alternate entry does not put you directly in his sight.

tasks.name: Chally Time
steps: Bring a halberd with a damaging special and save enough special-attack energy.
Lower Entry Mode Bloat's health during shutdowns, then stop ordinary attacks.
Use the halberd special as your final attack; do not let another hit or passive damage finish him first.

tasks.name: Nylocas, On the Rocks
steps: Bring Ice Barrage runes on Ancient Magicks to Entry Mode Nylocas.
Wait for four Nylocas close enough to fit within one spell's area, then target the group.
Freeze all four with that single cast; separate casts or a lower ice spell do not satisfy the task.

tasks.name: Just To Be Safe
steps: Enter Entry Mode Sotetseg with at least two players and agree a shared-ball meeting tile.
When the big ball comes, have the entire team group together so everyone shares its damage.
Survive that shared ball and finish Sotetseg; leaving even one teammate out misses the condition.

tasks.name: Don't Look at Me!
steps: During Entry Mode Xarpus's final phase, watch the direction he looks before attacking.
Stop attacking immediately when he turns toward you, and resume only while he looks elsewhere.
Everyone must avoid reflected damage throughout the kill.

tasks.name: No-Pillar
steps: Use Dawnbringer in Entry Mode Verzik's pillar phase while sheltering safely from her attacks.
Rotate protection between pillars before one loses its remaining health, and keep phase-one damage going.
Finish the pillar phase without any pillar being destroyed.

tasks.name: Attack, Step, Wait
steps: During Entry Mode Verzik phase two, attack and step back out of her bounce range before her next attack.
Keep the movement rhythm even while handling Nylocas and lightning.
Everyone must survive that phase without being bounced; standing adjacent after an attack is the usual failure.

tasks.name: Pass It On
steps: Run Entry Mode Verzik with a teammate and agree who will receive the green ball.
When targeted, move close enough to that teammate to pass the ball, then separate as needed.
Make one successful transfer rather than trying to tank it alone.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood: SM Speed-Chaser
steps: Start Entry Mode Theatre with efficient style switches and a room plan.
Kill healing/priority adds promptly, use Bloat shutdowns and move quickly between encounters.
Complete the whole raid in less than 17 minutes.

tasks.name: Theatre of Blood: SM Adept
steps: Select Entry Mode Theatre and bring all three attack styles plus healing supplies.
Complete Maiden, Bloat, Nylocas, Sotetseg and Xarpus, then defeat Verzik's three phases.
Finish the raid once; leaving before Verzik dies does not count.

tasks.name: Into the Den of Giants
steps: Enter the Giants' Den cave in Shayzien; bring a combat weapon and food.
Kill one Hill Giant, one Moss Giant and one Fire Giant inside that same cave.
Giants killed elsewhere do not satisfy this location-specific task.

tasks.name: Sit Back and Relax
steps: Use the Arceuus spellbook with a Book of the dead and runes for a resurrection spell.
Summon a thrall while fighting an NPC and allow it to attack your target.
Deal 100 total damage through undead thralls, resummoning after expiry; your own weapon damage does not count toward that total.

tasks.name: Phosani's Veteran
steps: Prepare melee boss damage, magic for totems and a parasite-weakening supply such as a Sanfew serum.
Match Phosani's attack animations with protection prayers, move clear of specials and remove husks/parasites quickly.
Charge the totems and handle sleepwalkers before finishing one kill.

tasks.name: Phosani's Master
steps: Bring melee and magic switches plus supplies to weaken parasites and restore prayer.
Avoid spores, handle husks/parasites and change protection prayers promptly through each phase.
Accumulate five Phosani kills; separate visits are allowed for this count task.

tasks.name: Phosani's Grandmaster
steps: Use a consistent Phosani setup with melee for the boss, magic for totems and parasite-weakening supplies.
Prioritise correct prayers and dangerous adds so kills remain sustainable.
Reach 25 total kills, banking between attempts when needed.

tasks.name: Perfect Phosani's Nightmare
steps: Weaken parasites and protect correctly against boss attacks; move clear of every avoidable special.
Stay clear of spores so they never slow your attacks, and kill sleepwalkers before they reach Phosani.
Finish with damage only from husks, power blasts and weakened parasites; any other damage fails the task.

tasks.name: Phosani's Speedchaser
steps: Prepare boosts and efficient melee/magic switches before entering Phosani's dream.
Keep boss and totem damage going while removing priority adds; avoid spores that slow attacks.
Finish within 7 minutes 30 seconds.

tasks.name: Phosani's Speedrunner
steps: Use a practised Phosani route with quick boss/totem switches and boosts ready.
Avoid spores and handle parasites, husks and sleepwalkers promptly without losing attack opportunities.
Finish within 6 minutes; unnecessary add delays or slow totem charging can cost the target.

tasks.name: Crush Hour
steps: Bring a crush setup capable of one-hitting the husks and weakened parasites, plus a Sanfew serum or other parasite-weakening supply.
Weaken each parasite before it emerges and kill every husk and parasite with one hit.
Keep lower-damage attacks and thralls from damaging those adds first; any add needing a second hit fails the task.

tasks.name: I Would Simply React
steps: In Phosani's prayer-disabling phase, react to the attack animation before switching to the required protection prayer.
Avoid leaving the correct protection active early where her attack can disable it.
Finish the kill without your prayer ever being disabled; reactivating it afterward does not undo a failure.

tasks.name: Dreamland Express
steps: Keep a quick weapon ready as Phosani enters her final desperation phase.
Prioritise every spawned sleepwalker immediately and kill it before it reaches her.
Continue attacking Phosani between walker spawns and finish with none reaching her in that phase.

tasks.name: Can't Wake Up
steps: Pack prayer restoration, parasite-weakening supplies and healing for five kills before entering Phosani's dream.
Conserve supplies through clean prayers/movement and use useful supply drops without exiting.
Complete five consecutive kills while remaining in the dream; leaving to bank breaks the sequence.

tasks.name: Nex Veteran
steps: Enter Nex with a team and supplies for all five phases.
Follow her phase cues, kill the named minion when it becomes vulnerable and dodge the special attacks.
Deal enough damage for kill-credit and finish one Nex kill.

tasks.name: Nex Master
steps: Prepare a consistent Nex team, effective ranged/melee weapons and sufficient healing/prayer supplies.
Follow phase changes and minion calls while avoiding dashes, shadows, blood healing and ice specials.
Accumulate 25 credited kills, banking between trips as needed.

tasks.name: Nex Survivors
steps: Agree safe Nex roles and keep every player supplied and healthy through all phases.
Move out of dashes/shadows, handle blood and ice mechanics, and kill vulnerable minions promptly.
Finish with nobody dying; one teammate's death fails the whole team condition.

tasks.name: A siphon will solve this
steps: When Nex begins Blood Siphon, stop attacking her until the healing period ends.
Kill blood reavers before a later siphon can heal her from their remaining health.
Resume damage only after the siphon and finish the kill without it restoring any Nex health.

tasks.name: Contain this!
steps: During Nex's ice phase, move outside the containment icicles before they erupt.
Free an imprisoned teammate by breaking an icicle and have them escape before the prison detonates.
Finish with no player taking damage from any ice special; tanking a prison blast does not qualify.

tasks.name: There is no escape!
steps: Watch Nex's facing and the Smoke Dash cue during her smoke phase.
Move every player out of the aisle she is about to charge through.
Finish the kill without anyone being hit by a dash; being protected from ordinary attacks is insufficient.

tasks.name: Nex Trio
steps: Start the Nex fight with no more than three players present.
Coordinate minion switches and mechanics carefully so the small team preserves its supplies.
Finish the kill at that qualifying starting scale; starting with four then losing a player does not qualify.

tasks.name: Nex Duo
steps: Start Nex with no more than two players and supplies for a long fight.
Coordinate damage, minion priority and ice-prison rescues while avoiding her other specials.
Finish the kill with the starting-scale restriction met; deaths after a larger start do not make it a duo attempt.

tasks.name: I should see a doctor
steps: Have a player acquire Nex's coughing infection during the smoke phase.
Track that player's cough status through the fight and avoid finishing while nobody is coughing.
Kill Nex while at least one player is still coughing.

tasks.name: Perfect Nex
steps: Keep every teammate outside Nex's Smoke Dash route and move off Shadow Smash markers.
Stop damage during Blood Siphon and remove reavers before they heal her.
Avoid containment and rescue ice-prison targets before damage; complete all four conditions together in one Nex kill.

tasks.name: Shadows Move...
steps: Watch for Shadow Smash markers under players during Nex's shadow phase.
Move off each marked tile before it erupts and avoid moving onto another player's marker.
Finish with no teammate hit by Shadow Smash.

tasks.name: Tombs Speed Runner
steps: Choose normal Tombs of Amascut raid level 150-299 and prepare a quick path order for your chosen team size.
Keep puzzle time and boss transitions short, and use safe damage windows efficiently.
Complete the full normal raid within 18 minutes.

tasks.name: Tombs Speed Runner II
steps: Set invocations to Expert Mode, raid level at least 300, and choose a route your team can execute quickly.
Assign puzzle jobs and keep boss damage going without delays from failed mechanics.
Complete the expert raid within 20 minutes at the chosen group size.

tasks.name: Tombs Speed Runner III
steps: Form an eight-player team and set an Expert Mode raid level of at least 300.
Assign puzzle, add and boss responsibilities so all eight contribute without waiting.
Complete the expert raid within 18 minutes with the required group size.

tasks.name: You are not prepared
steps: Remove outside consumable supplies before entering Tombs; plan to use only supplies obtained inside the raid.
Manage health carefully before the Helpful Spirit and share internal supplies as needed.
Complete the whole raid with no deaths and nobody consuming outside supplies.

tasks.name: Helpful spirit who?
steps: Bring enough of your own supplies for the entire Tombs raid.
Do not use Helpful Spirit supplies or honey locusts, even in an emergency.
Finish with no deaths anywhere; consuming a restricted supply or one teammate dying fails the task.

tasks.name: Resourceful Raider
steps: Enable On a diet and Dehydration and enter an Expert raid at level 300 or above.
Bring permitted healing: a blood fury for melee sustain and, if available, a sun-Keris, Saradomin godsword or toxic blowpipe healing special.
Pack prayer potions or super restores; reserve Prayer for sun-Keris healing and choose Power supplies instead of nectar or ambrosia.
Complete the raid without any player dying; food and HP-restoring potions cannot be used.

tasks.name: But... Damage
steps: Check every party member's equipment and switches; exclude any item at tier 75 or above.
Use qualifying lower-tier weapons and armour throughout every room, including special-attack switches.
Complete the raid without anyone wearing or holding forbidden equipment at any point.

tasks.name: Chompington
steps: Use melee attacks only against Zebak; remove ranged/magic damage and thralls from your plan.
Change protection prayers for his ranged/magic projectiles, dodge waves and blood, and shelter behind a cleared rock during roars.
Finish Zebak without dying; his basic attacks do not all use one style.

tasks.name: Fancy feet
steps: Enter with at least two players and activate Insanity before the raid.
During Wardens phase three, attack only with melee while moving to the safe left/right/centre lanes and clearing skulls.
Remember Insanity resumes the slam sequence after skulls; continue through enrage without dying or using forbidden attacks.

tasks.name: Hardcore Raiders
steps: Start Tombs with at least two players and agree safe path and boss roles.
Top up health/prayer between rooms and handle specials before pursuing extra damage.
Complete the entire raid with no death by anyone; recovering from a wipe still fails this task.

tasks.name: Hardcore Tombs
steps: Start Tombs alone with supplies and an invocation setup you can complete reliably.
Handle every path and Wardens without rushing low-health situations.
Complete the solo raid without dying anywhere.

tasks.name: Perfect Het
steps: Set the Het mirrors so the light reaches the shielded core while keeping yourself out of the beam and moving orbs.
Have a pickaxe ready and mine the core immediately after its first exposure.
Destroy it in that single exposure with no beam or orb damage taken.

tasks.name: Perfect Akkha
steps: Start Akkha with at least two players and all Akkha invocations enabled.
Match weapons to his unprotected style and overheads to his attacks; clear shadows before their timers explode.
Have everyone avoid memory, detonate and orb damage, including enrage orbs, and never hit him with a wrong style.

tasks.name: Perfection of Het
steps: Use a group of at least two and all Akkha invocations for this combined Het/Akkha attempt.
Solve Het with no beam/orb damage and destroy the core on its first exposure.
At Akkha, keep every player's style/prayer correct, clear shadow timers and avoid all special/enrage orbs in the same raid.

tasks.name: Perfect Apmeken
steps: Enter Apmeken with at least two players and divide baboon styles and danger-response jobs.
Act on vent, pillar and corruption calls before they trigger; keep clear of venom and volatile baboons.
Complete the room in less than three minutes with none of those failures by anyone.

tasks.name: Perfect Ba-Ba
steps: Start Ba-Ba with at least two players and every Ba-Ba invocation active; leave all sarcophagi closed.
Use the correct protection for ordinary attacks and move out of slams and falling-rock markers.
Handle rubble safely and break/pass rolling boulders without anyone taking listed damage.

tasks.name: Perfection of Apmeken
steps: Use at least two players and all Ba-Ba invocations for this combined Apmeken/Ba-Ba run.
Clear Apmeken by responding to every danger and avoiding venom and volatile baboons; this combined task has no three-minute room limit.
Leave sarcophagi closed and complete Ba-Ba with correct protection and no slam, boulder, rubble or falling-rock damage by anyone.
Complete both clean rooms during the same raid; they do not need to be consecutive.

tasks.name: Perfect Crondis
steps: Plan the Crondis water route and assign someone to kill crocodiles before they reach the tree.
Fill containers, move around the room's obstacles without spilling water, and deliver each load promptly.
Complete the room in under one minute with no crocodile reaching the tree and nobody losing carried water.

tasks.name: Perfect Zebak
steps: Enable every Zebak invocation before entry and have everyone protect against his ranged/magic projectiles.
Avoid poison, blood spawns and waves; use safe rocks for roar cover.
Push no more than two jugs over the entire fight; destroy stationary ones when needed and finish with no listed damage by anyone.
